overview: Paludal Caverns is a sprawling subterranean network connecting the surface regions of Luclin to Shadow Haven. Its tunnels are filled with fungal groves, dangerous beasts, and bandit factions.
history: Originally natural caverns, Paludal expanded as smugglers carved new tunnels to Shadow Haven. During the Terror of Luclin era, shadow anomalies began appearing deeper within the caverns.
hooks: A Shadow Haven smuggler ring collapses after a botched deal.
Fungal blooms spread rapidly, choking off travel corridors.
Shadow anomalies distort navigation deeper in the caverns.
A bandit leader seeks to unify the scattered warrens.
Vah Shir scouts report missing travelers near the lower tunnels.
